question_text: Under the 1987 Philippine Constitution, legislative power is vested in the Congress of the Philippines, which consists of __?

options.text: The Senate and the House of Representatives
The Supreme Court and Lower Courts
The Civil Service Commission and Commission on Audit

hint_ladder.title: Identify Branch of Government
hint_ladder.text: Think about which branch is responsible for making laws. That’s the legislative branch, and in the Philippines, it’s called Congress.

hint_ladder.title: Bicameral Structure
hint_ladder.text: Congress is bicameral—two houses. This is stated in Article VI of the 1987 Constitution.

hint_ladder.title: Identify Chambers
hint_ladder.text: The two houses are the Senate (upper) and the House of Representatives (lower). Together, they make up Congress.

hint_ladder.title: Select Option A
hint_ladder.text: Option A matches exactly: the Senate and the House of Representatives. Art. VI, Sec. 1 ng Constitution ang basis nito.

A.text: Correct. Art. VI, Sec. 1 vests legislative power in Congress, composed of the Senate and the House of Representatives.

B.text: You might have chosen B because the President and Cabinet are powerful, but they execute laws—making laws is Congress's job.

C.text: You might have chosen C because courts interpret laws, but they don't create them—that's Congress's exclusive role.

D.text: You might have chosen D because the CSC and COA are constitutional bodies, but they are oversight, not legislative.

next_time_rule: Legislative power = Congress = Senate + House. Branch Test: Makes laws=Legislative, Enforces=Executive, Interprets=Judiciary.
blueprint_id: 1987 Philippine Constitution — Article VI Section 1 Legislative Department
deconstruct_text:
Isipin mo nasa barangay hall tayo. May session ang Sanggunian, nagpapasa ng ordinansa—iyan ang local na batas. Pero sa national level, ang gumagawa ng batas ay ang Congress.

Dalawa ang bahay: Senado (Upper House) at Kamara de Representantes (Lower House). Parang jeepney: dalawang compartment, iisa ang ruta—paggawa ng batas. Bawal sumakay ang Presidente o Korte, kanya-kanyang sakayan yan.

Mnemonics: 'Congress = Con (container) ng Senado at House.' Tandaan: yung 'Con' parang lalagyan ng dalawang chambers. At 'Legislative' parang 'list' nila ang mga batas. Legal basis: Art. VI, Sec. 1, 1987 Constitution.
